title: Feature card · image left + copy
description: Mirror of BOD-02. On mobile the photo stacks above the copy.
usage: Feature card on a grey panel. Short benefit headline + 2–3 lines of copy; the photo carries the proof. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: JPG, cover. Left corners rounded 8px inline.
JPG, cover crop of the same photo. Shown above the copy on mobile; top corners rounded 8px inline.

notes: Columns stack on mobile with drop (≤ 480px); source order already puts the photo first, so no dir="rtl" trick is needed.

The photo changes aspect ratio on mobile (276x250 to full-width x 150), so the module ships two crops: the desktop image has h and the mobile crop has dis-block + fluid (hidden inline with display:none; mso-hide:all). Replace both when swapping the photo.
The swap uses h rather than mobile-hidden because mobile-hidden also fires at 481–640px, where dis-block and drop don't, which would leave no photo at all.
Mobile: panel padding 16/24 snaps to 10 top (padd-none) and 15 sides (pad15); bottom stays 16 (Figma 8). Card padding is mobPad16 (exact). Heading-to-body gap 16 snaps to 10 (padd-none; Figma 8).
Heading uses f24 (28 → 24), matching the Mobile frame.
